dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.soa.1: Lucy, slow down. Tell it properly. What did you see?
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.lucy.1: A girl. Out in the clearing past the village. I'd lose sight of her in the flowers, then catch her again.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.soa.2: Then do not chase her. If someone goes, they go gently and give her room.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.lucy.2: I know. I made a sketch before I started doubting what I saw.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line1: Listen. I saw a girl alone in a clearing nearby.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line2: She did not look hurt, and she did not look lost. Just... watchful. Like she was measuring everything.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line3: Do not walk in trying to save her. Go slowly, look first, and let her decide the distance.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line4: Here. Take the sketch. It should get you there.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.received: Lucy presses the sketch into your hand while SoaMarjorie makes the warning plain with a steady look.
dialogue.lucy.scene.replacement.line1: You lost the sketch? Fine. I made another.
dialogue.lucy.scene.replacement.line2: And this time, listen to SoaMarjorie: no noise when you get there.
dialogue.lucy.scene.repeat.line1: You already have it. Go carefully and do not startle her.
dialogue.lucy.scene.after_discovery.line: Well. That settles that. No more handing sketches around the village.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_intro.line1: If Lucy is this unsettled, she saw something real.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_intro.line2: Go if you want, but be careful. Do not crowd her.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_repeat.line1: What matters is simple: stay calm, be respectful, and keep your eyes open.
